summary: Image tags are the channel and the date, without the identity hash
compatibility: New images are tagged like karmic-kraken-20261008; a second image the same day is karmic-kraken-20261008.2. Images published earlier keep their names, and the karmic-kraken and karmic-kraken-beta aliases are unchanged.
details: The assembly identity stays in the GitHub release and in the image metadata. Spark images follow the same names, for example karmic-kraken-beta-spark-20261008.
